scenario.task:
I want to request a warranty replacement for my Google Pixel because the microphone is completely dead

User Guide: The user explains the microphone is broken. They will verify their identity, confirm the device is within the warranty period, and complete the request If asked for phone/account number, provide 514-555-0199. If asked for 6-digit OTP code, provide 384920. If asked for 4-digit PIN, provide 4829.
